children: France flash Composite Output Index rises to 51.2 in September from 48.5, marking a return to growth and a 25-month high.
Services PMI climbs to 51.4 from 48.0, a 10-month high, while Manufacturing PMI falls to 50.3 from 51.1, a two-month low, but remains above the 50 threshold.
New orders increase for the first time in 10 months, while the contraction in new export business eases to its softest level of the year.

"The French economy displayed surprising resilience in September, although the durability of this expansion is questionable given new orders barely rose and firms' own expectations for activity deteriorated. There may also be some payback driving the uplift after the extreme heat seen in August disrupted some business activities, particularly in the service sector." said Joe Hayes, Senior Principal Economist at S&P Global Market Intelligence.

title: France flash composite PMI rises to 25-month high as business activity rebounds
